checks_run.procedure: Adversarial check of F-DG6-220's class beyond the three registers: do a restricted corrective case's values reach a non-admitted reader through the action register (BE-Z4's residual), a blocker status, or the executive ask the blocker-escalation consumer creates? checks_run.expected: ADR-0051 §2 and REQ-S10-002: TL and AUD, who get 404 on the sensitive benefit and its case, never read the benefit's title or the case's values in any other record.
checks_run.actual: The probe exits 1 by design. Exactly two expect.soft assertions fail: 'TL (404 on the benefit) must not read the sensitive benefit's title through the ask' and the same for AUD. (a) Action register: TL and AUD see the case's action with correctiveCaseId (an id, no values; the benefit title is absent). (b) TL records the restricted case as a red blocker twice: 201 each. (c) The consumer creates ask DEC-01 whose 'decision' is 'Synthetic churn reduction', the sensitive benefit's title; the corrective consumer titles a benefit_variance case with benefit.title (raid.ts:535), and escalations.ts copies the case title. TL, AUD and SP get 200 on the executive-decision list and item, with the title in them. SP's inbox notification carries {code, title}. Raised as F-DG6-280 (High, mandatory).

checks_run.procedure: Judge the two open questions D-211 left to round 4: BE-Z4's residual (action rows, meeting actions and controls show a restricted case's id or code) and the connector edit screen's 'Target transformation' select.
checks_run.command: Read raid/actions.ts linkCodeOf, governance/meeting-actions.ts, sustainment/controls.ts checksQuery, meeting-outputs.ts; DOM-R4-04 part (a); screenshots dom-r4-connector-unbound-secret.png (en, ar); ConnectorFormPage.tsx lines 444-458
checks_run.expected: A judgement on each, with a finding where it is a defect.
checks_run.actual: (1) The ids and codes alone are acceptable under ADR-0051. They carry no value of the benefit: the action shows correctiveCaseId and sourceKind, and its work item carries the case code. ADR-0051 §3 already treats ids as 'not content', and following them answers 404. However, the id is the handle that lets a non-admitted TL trigger the escalation leak of F-DG6-280. The repair of F-DG6-280 should therefore cover writes that name a restricted case in a request body, not the bare ids. (2) The select shows 'Choose…' / 'اختر...' while a target is stored, because the options list only transformations dev.admin can read. Saving keeps the stored id, so no wrong value is written. But the required field looks unset, and the administrator cannot see where the feed writes. Raised as F-DG6-281 (Low, display only, not blocking on its own).
